_about: How scripts/fetch_rijal.py talks to sunnah.com. Read by that script only.
impersonate: the browser the request looks like; sunnah.com refuses plain HTTP clients.
pace_seconds: wait between two requests, so the site is never hammered.
timeout_seconds and retries: per request; a block (403, 429) or a failure after the last retry stops the run, and the cache lets the next run resume.
